environment.description: Node.js 16 Apollo Server 3.x deployed on ECS Fargate in us-east-1. Single task with desiredCount=1, no health check grace period configured. ECS service has direct internet-facing ALB. S3 bucket 'user-data-exports-prod' accessible via standard S3 endpoint with IAM role attached to task having s3:PutObject and s3:GetObject permissions. No request validation middleware. Apollo Server running with NODE_ENV=production but no process-level uncaught exception handler beyond the plugin.
